date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}


get_person_info <- function(url) {

  Sys.sleep(1)
  page <- read_html(url)

  # Birthday
  birth_node <- page |> html_element(".bday")

  birthday <- if (inherits(birth_node, "xml_missing")) {
    as.Date(NA)
  } else {
    suppressWarnings(as.Date(html_text2(birth_node)))
  }

  # Find the birth-place element in the infobox
  place_node <- page |>
    html_element(".infobox .birthplace, .infobox .birth-place")

  birthplace <- if (inherits(place_node, "xml_missing")) {
    NA_character_
  } else {
    html_text2(place_node)
  }

  tibble(
    from = birthplace,
    birthday = birthday
  )
}


```


```{r}

season_1_full <- season_1 |>
  mutate(
    info = map(wiki_url, function(url) {
      tryCatch(
        get_person_info(url),
        error = function(e) {
          tibble(
            from = NA_character_,
            birthday = as.Date(NA)
          )
        }
      )
    })
  ) |>
  unnest(info) |>
  mutate(
    premiere_date = as.Date("2005-06-01"),
    age = as.integer(
      floor(time_length(
        interval(birthday, premiere_date),
        "years"
      ))
    )
  ) |>
  select(season, celebrity, from, profession, age)

```

```{r}

season_1_full <- season_1_full |>
  mutate(
    from = case_when(
      celebrity == "Trista Sutter" ~ "St. Louis, Missouri",
      celebrity == "Evander Holyfield" ~ "Atlanta, Georgia",
      TRUE ~ from
    )
  )

View(season_1_full)

```
